claims.assertion: Act XVII of 2022 applies to listed consumer products and services.

sources.evidence: The law enumerates product and service categories including electronic communications, transport, banking, e-books and e-commerce.

claims.assertion: A Hungarian EAA body explicitly requires a dedicated public page comparable to a WAD statement.
claims.review_note: A WAD statement on NMHH's own website does not establish a general EAA publication requirement.

claims.assertion: Service providers publicly disclose accessibility compliance documentation and describe it in general terms or equivalent document.

sources.evidence: Service documentation must be public in accessible written and oral form; Annex 3 specifies general terms or equivalent document.

claims.assertion: The public receives the documentation only on request.
Providers must give necessary compliance information to the authority when asked.

sources.evidence: The provider gives the competent authority information and documentation to substantiate compliance upon request.

claims.assertion: NMHH has a limited EAA remit and is not the general consumer-protection authority.

sources.evidence: The current decree assigns certain products and communications/audiovisual access services to NMHH, other services to consumer protection, and banking to the central bank.

claims.scope: NMHH product categories and communications/audiovisual access services; other sectors assigned elsewhere.

claims.assertion: A concrete sector-specific EAA complaint route is verified.

sources.evidence: Consumers may initiate proceedings; the decree defines application contents but does not provide a destination.

claims.review_note: Do not publish a generic NMHH or consumer protection contact until an EAA-relevant official route is confirmed.

claims.assertion: A concrete company reporting channel to a competent Hungarian EAA authority is verified.
claims.review_note: No usable channel confirmed for a specified sector.

questions: Identify official complaint form/email/postal address per competent authority and sector.
Check whether any competent monitoring body demands a dedicated public page.
Map the full current authority roster from the amended decree, including central-bank remit.
